items.title: IonQ Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: Raises full-year 2026 revenue expectations to between $260 million and $270 million; second-quarter guidance between $65 million and $68 million. Notes remaining performance obligations grew 554% year-on-year to $470 million.

items.title: IonQ Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Reported $130.0 million of annual revenue. Said 2026 revenue guidance was between $225 million and $245 million, with first-quarter guidance between $48 million and $51 million.

items.title: 2025 Annual Report
items.snippet: SEC annual report discussing risk factors, including dependence on market and business conditions, funding/liquidity needs, and potential adverse effects on the value of common stock.
